text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Royce and Royce, I decided 
to ask her for some advice—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You want to do some self-analysis? What's 
this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing oneself helps in formulating race 
strategy. What kind of thinking you excel 
at, and what perspectives you struggle to 
grasp—"
choice_data_list:
I want to understand my own traits and put 
them to strategic use

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's an admirable attitude! In 
that case, I'll give you a Royce-chan 
Style Personality Test, devised from 
experience and data!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Follow me. I know the perfect spot just a 
few stations away.♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This is a world apart from the everyday. 
It's precisely in extraordinary situations 
that one's true nature shows vividly.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin! It's time for the Royce-chan 
Personality Diagnosis!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Paon-kun the elephant in costume! 
Ehehe, he's so popular, isn't he?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what kind of person is inside. 
I'll give you some choices, so try to 
guess."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
1. Someone as cute as they look 2. There's 
no one inside 3. An elderly person 4. A 
mechanical remote control—Which do you 
think it is?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From what I can see at a distance, her 
movements are remarkably sharp. I could 
sense the craftsmanship of a seasoned 
veteran.
choice_data_list: No. 3... maybe

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see, that just measured your level of 
caution. Caution level 80%—you're quite 
the suspicious one, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And it's the exact same as my 
subconscious! Talk about an instant 
character overlap...
choice_data_list:
I-It's easier to communicate with kindred 
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's just say that's the case! 
Moving on to the next diagnosis.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to Western Shooting! Take down 
the targets popping out!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, I wonder what kind of target will 
appear first.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
1. An old friend 2. A skilled gunslinger 
3. A tavern bartender 4. A sheriff— What's 
your answer?
choice_data_list: Um, #2, the master gunslinger!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Number 2, right? But before that♪ Let's 
clear this game first!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: "—Are you ready? Shooting, start!!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Good work. What I discovered this time is 
the person you've secretly been aiming to 
surpass.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
For you who chose #2, the skilled 
gunslinger, you project your ideals onto 
those with proven track records.
choice_data_list: Is that... actually a good result...?

I wonder if that's really a good 
result...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's not a matter of good or bad. For 
example, if an up-and-coming racing theory 
is proposed, it means making a conscious 
effort to consider it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That expands your strategic options, 
doesn't it? Use it as a springboard for 
your ideas!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go. We've walked around a 
lot, so let's take a little break!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Before that, our customary personality 
quiz! What flavor do you think this 
popcorn is?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
1. Salt 2. Caramel 3. Butter 4. Mix— So, 
which one?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first thing that immediately came to 
mind was standard salt, so—
choice_data_list: Salt No. 1!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you're the type to plan ahead. 
Those who chose salt from the options can 
be said to be highly organized planners.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looked at another way, she might not be 
well-suited for strategies aimed at 
short-term goals...
choice_data_list: Thanks, that was really helpful!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the personality test. Good 
work. From the results, I've figured out 
your type as well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
An unsung hero, a support type! In short, 
perfectly suited to be a Trainer.
choice_data_list: Oh, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still, you could stand to be a bit more 
adventurous. If you build up more desire 
to take on challenges, I'm sure it will 
lead to great results.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By the way♪ My compatibility with you is 
80%!
choice_data_list:
Ahaha, I'm relieved it's on the higher 
side.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Really? Since we're at it, don't you want 
to try pushing it all the way to 100%?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
âAh, the sound of the parade. Good 
timing. Want to try a bonus diagnosis?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Aiming for 100% compatibility with me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Look, they're getting closer— ...Ugh, 
looks like we can't move any further 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce looks like she's about to 
be swept away by the crowd. For her 
safety, I'd better stick to supporting her 
from the sidelines.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, Trainer-san. Can you even see from 
there?"
choice_data_list:
No, I'll be your shield so you don't get 
pushed around in the crowd.

No, I'll be a shield so you won't get 
pushed around by the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is your choice... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You and me. Looks like this is going to be 
a much longer relationship than I thought♪
choice_data_list:
Huh, that was part of the examination 
too!?
Huh, that was part of the diagnosis too!?

I'm planning on sticking with you for the 
long haul, right from the start!

I'm planning on sticking with you for the 
long haul, right from the start, okay?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You and me. Looks like this is going to be 
a much longer relationship than I thought♪
choice_data_list:
Huh, that was part of the examination 
too!?
Huh, that was part of the diagnosis too!?

I'm planning on sticking with you for the 
long haul, right from the start!

I'm planning on sticking with you for the 
long haul, right from the start, okay?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't it obvious? Did you let your 
guard down, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"So you were truly trying to protect me on 
instinct. That adds credibility to the 
diagnosis."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With us, even 120% compatibility isn't 
just a dream. Shall we do some more 
fortune-telling?♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, that works out perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I place great importance on the checkup 
results of my partner, so I'm relieved.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you again, 
100% Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I replied that the pleasure was mine, 
she returned a warm smile.
